about.summary: Cross platform, open source application for the processing, visualization, and analysis of 3D tomography data
Cross platform, open source application for the processing, visualization, and analysis of 3D tomography data

about.description:
This package provides the Python pipeline execution tools from the Tomviz
project, enabling command-line execution of tomviz operators and pipelines
without the full GUI application. It includes the tomviz Python library and
the tomviz-pipeline command-line tool for processing tomographic data.

This package is also required when using the Tomviz Desktop application's
ExternalPython execution mode, where pipelines run in a separate conda
environment from the main application. The package must be installed
in that separate conda environment.
about.summary: Python pipeline execution tools for tomviz

raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "tomviz" %}
{% set version = "3.0.0" %}
{% set paraview_version = "6.1.1" %}
{% set python_min = "3.11" %}
{% set build_number = 0 %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}-split
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  - git_url: https://github.com/OpenChemistry/tomviz
    git_rev: {{ version }}
    folder: tomviz
  # Submodules updated in build.sh: pybind11
  # conda-fixes.patch was dropped for 3.0: every hunk is now upstream, or
  # targeted a file that no longer exists.

build:
  number: {{ build_number }}

outputs:
  # First output: main tomviz desktop application
  - name: tomviz
    script: build_tomviz.sh   # [unix]
    script: build_tomviz.bat  # [win]
    build:
      number: {{ build_number }}
      # py310 is skipped: the paraview 6.1.1 py310 osx-64 package is broken
      # (missing jsoncpp symbol at import time)
      skip: true  # [py < 311]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - git
      host:
        - python
        - paraview =={{ paraview_version }}
        - vtk
        - tbb-devel
        - libxml2-devel 2.14*
        - libprotobuf
      run:
        - python
        - numpy
        - scipy
        - h5py
        - click
        - tqdm
        - marshmallow
        - jsonpatch
        - jsonpointer
        - pyfftw
        - pygments
    test:
      imports:
        - paraview
        - paraview.simple
        - paraview.numpy_support
        - tomviz
        - tomviz.cli
        - tomviz._wrapping
        - tomviz._realtime.ctvlib
      commands:
        - test -f $PREFIX/bin/tomviz  # [unix]
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libtomvizcore${SHLIB_EXT}  # [unix]
        - "! ldd $PREFIX/bin/tomviz | grep 'not found'"  # [linux]
        - "! ldd $PREFIX/lib/libtomvizcore${SHLIB_EXT} | grep 'not found'"  # [linux]
        - "! otool -L $PREFIX/bin/tomviz | grep 'not found'"  # [osx]
        - "! otool -L $PREFIX/lib/libtomvizcore${SHLIB_EXT} | grep 'not found'"  # [osx]
        - "timeout 20 tomviz || test $? -eq 124"  # [osx]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\\tomviz.exe exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\\tomvizcore.dll exit 1  # [win]
        - powershell -Command "$p = Start-Process tomviz -PassThru; Start-Sleep 20; if ($p.HasExited) { exit 1 } else { Stop-Process $p; exit 0 }"  # [win]
      requires:
        - coreutils  # [osx]
    about:
      home: https://github.com/OpenChemistry/tomviz
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_family: BSD
      license_file:
        - tomviz/LICENSE
      summary: 'Cross platform, open source application for the processing, visualization, and analysis of 3D tomography data'
      doc_url: https://tomviz.readthedocs.io/
      dev_url: https://github.com/OpenChemistry/tomviz

  # Second output: tomviz-pipeline Python package
  - name: tomviz-pipeline
    script: build_tomviz-pipeline.sh   # [unix]
    script: build_tomviz-pipeline.bat  # [win]
    build:
      number: {{ build_number }}
      noarch: python
      skip: true  # [not linux or py != 311]  # Only build once on py311 for Linux
      # Without this, conda-smithy drops python from the set of variables used
      # to split CI jobs on linux (it intersects the loop vars of all outputs,
      # and this noarch output does not loop over python), which squishes all
      # python versions into a single linux job.
      force_use_keys:
        - python
      entry_points:
        - tomviz-pipeline = tomviz.cli:main
    requirements:
      host:
        - python {{ python_min }}
        - pip
        - setuptools
      run:
        - python >={{ python_min }}
        - numpy
        - scipy
        - h5py
        - click
        - tqdm
        - marshmallow
        - jsonpatch
        - jsonpointer
        - pyfftw
    test:
      imports:
        - tomviz
        - tomviz.cli
        - tomviz.operators
      commands:
        - tomviz-pipeline --help
        - python -c "import tomviz; print('tomviz imported successfully')"
      requires:
        - python {{ python_min }}
        - pip
    about:
      home: https://github.com/OpenChemistry/tomviz
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_family: BSD
      license_file:
        - tomviz/LICENSE
      summary: 'Python pipeline execution tools for tomviz'
      description: |
        This package provides the Python pipeline execution tools from the Tomviz
        project, enabling command-line execution of tomviz operators and pipelines
        without the full GUI application. It includes the tomviz Python library and
        the tomviz-pipeline command-line tool for processing tomographic data.

        This package is also required when using the Tomviz Desktop application's
        ExternalPython execution mode, where pipelines run in a separate conda
        environment from the main application. The package must be installed
        in that separate conda environment.
      doc_url: https://tomviz.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pipelines.html
      dev_url: https://github.com/OpenChemistry/tomviz

# This extra "about" section is a requirement by conda-forge, even
# though it's not actually used.
about:
  home: https://github.com/OpenChemistry/tomviz
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_family: BSD
  license_file:
    - tomviz/LICENSE
  summary: 'Cross platform, open source application for the processing, visualization, and analysis of 3D tomography data'
  doc_url: https://tomviz.readthedocs.io/
  dev_url: https://github.com/OpenChemistry/tomviz

extra:
  feedstock-name: tomviz
  recipe-maintainers:
    - cjh1
    - psavery
    - conda-forge/event-model
